notes.title: Curse of Anabelle - 13.03.2020 Update
notes.content:
With this update, we tried to provide you with some additional content. You may get a little bit more scared from this point on. So watch out! ːsteamhappyː

What we have done so far and and build upon with this update:

• Green Mountain Cemetery: The problem that causes the headstone to break by itself has been fixed.
• In-game map updated with ritual room numbers.
• Various localisation fixes.
• Running effect while being chased has been revised.
• Shadow settings has been revised. Game should run a little bit more optimized.
• Light distances are now fixed.
• Outline of some of the objects has been revised. Now they can be seen more clearly.
• QTE fight system has been revised. Now players will have a little bit more time to react both incoming attacks and inputting commands.
• On-screen notification system has been revised. It now gives players more clues about the gameplay.
• Compass system has been revised. Now players can clearly track the ritual rooms and crafting objects. (Players still able to complete the game without following the provided order of items and rituals)
• In-game map system has been revised. Now players can clearly track the ritual rooms and crafting objects. (Players still able to complete the game without following the provided order of items and rituals)
• The bug that causes players to teleport out-of-map when “time manipulation” ability used has been fixed.
• In game notification and guiding system has been reworked.

notes.title: Curse of Anabelle - 22.02.2020 Patch
notes.content:
For our first update, we got a lot of feedback. So here are things that we did:

• Green Mountain Cemetery: The problem that causes the headstone to break by itself has been fixed.
• In-game map updated with ritual room numbers.
• Various localisation fixes.
• Running effect while being chased has been revised.
• Shadow settings has been revised. Game should run a little bit more optimized.
• Outline of some of the objects has been revised. Now they can be seen more clearly.

Upcoming:

• QTE fight system will be revised. Players will have a little bit more time to react both incoming attacks and inputting commands.
• Notification problem in the HUD about the “Light of David” will be fixed.
• Compass and notification systems will be completely revised to guide the player more accurately to the ritual rooms and crafting objects.
• In-game guiding system for the players will be completely revised according to the feedback from you guys.

We will be working day and night to give you a better experience. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Curse of Anabelle is now live!!!
notes.content:
Hi,

Our game Curse of Anabelle is released on Steam today.

We originally planned for release at 14:00 GMT. But because of a backend configuration problem of Steam we got unintentionally delayed. When we dove into the Steam developer forums, we discovered that numerous developers had the same issue in the past 24 hours. So we just waited.

Unfortunately all of the content we prepared for you over the past week and today has been interrupted due to this misfortune. We thank you for your patience and interest, and apologize for the delay.

Rocwise Team
